gloss: prefectural resident; citizen of a prefecture

definitions.gloss: prefectural resident; citizen of a prefecture
definitions.explanation: A person who lives in a particular prefecture of Japan, used in administrative and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {県民|けんみん}の{声|こえ}を{聞|き}く。
examples.english: To listen to the voices of prefectural residents.

examples.japanese: {県民|けんみん}{税|ぜい}は{毎年|まいとし}{六月|ろくがつ}に{届|とど}く。
examples.english: The prefectural resident tax notice arrives every June.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{知事|ちじ}は{県民|けんみん}の{期待|きたい}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: The new governor is drawing the expectations of prefectural residents.

notes:
A compound of {県|けん} (prefecture) + {民|みん} (people, citizens). Refers to people who reside in one of Japan's 47 prefectures, used in government, media, and everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県民|けんみん}{税|ぜい}: prefectural resident tax
- {県民|けんみん}{投票|とうひょう}: prefectural referendum
- {県民|けんみん}{性|せい}: regional character of a prefecture's people
- {県民|けんみん}{所得|しょとく}: prefectural per capita income

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都民|とみん}: Tokyo resident — same pattern but for Tokyo specifically
- {市民|しみん}: city resident — refers to residents of a city rather than a prefecture
- {国民|こくみん}: national citizen — refers to the people of a country as a whole
- {府民|ふみん}: resident of Osaka or Kyoto prefecture (which use {府|ふ} instead of {県|けん})
